title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East (Late Show) on 1968-06-14
source: Source: Audience Cassette Master > Reel > pcm (sony HG tape) provided by Tim Dalton; Transfer: ocm > Sony SL-10 > Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro > Tascam DA-3000 > WAV 16/44.1 - Transferred By Charlie Miller; Lineage: wav > iZotope RX6 Advanced > iZotope 5 Advanced > CD Wave > TLH > Flac 16; edited and mastered SIRMick February 2018

ai_review.summary: Historic Fillmore East audience tape delivers a legendary St. Stephen and strong Caution despite modest vocal clarity and some distortion.
ai_review.review: The show shines with an early‑era, “insane” version of St. Stephen and a powerful Caution suite highlighted by Pigpen’s harp work, making it a must‑hear for Deadheads. The audience recording has been EQ‑balanced but still suffers from muddy vocals and lingering tape distortion, keeping the listening experience from being pristine.

ai_rating.rationale: Performance is widely praised (especially St. Stephen) while recording quality is noted as decent but with vocal clarity and distortion issues, leading to a solid but not perfect overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Improved balance and EQ fixes present, but vocals are not crisp and some tape distortion remains, limiting clarity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Unusual sequencing (Alligator > Lovelight > Caution) creates an odd but effective flow; the early St. Stephen showcases a pivotal moment in the band's evolution.

band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s harp work during the Caution reprise is noted as strong.
